summary: This Form 8-K is a routine distribution notice from Structured Obligations Corporation, as registrant, regarding the Select Notes Trust LT 2003-1. The filing reports the August 17, 2026 interest distribution to certificate holders, including the interest amount received ($168,750) and per-certificate income for Form 1099. The registrant and trustee disclaim participation in preparing underlying issuer reports and do not verify their accuracy. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, restructuring, or strategic actions; this is an ordinary asset-backed securities periodic distribution event.
